subject.title: fix: classify provider code-only failover errors

question: Should this PR land with these provider-owned code-to-failover mappings for OpenAI, Google-family, and Anthropic code-only errors?
rationale: The patch shape matches the provider boundary, but the exact mapping semantics affect fallback and cooldown behavior for existing provider routes and should be accepted by a maintainer before merge.

options.title: Land Provider-Hook Mappings
options.body: Accept the current mappings after exact-head checks finish because the code is scoped to provider hooks and has focused proof.

options.title: Adjust One Or More Mappings
options.body: Ask for a narrow mapping change if a provider owner wants different failover or cooldown semantics for a vendor code.

options.title: Pause For Broader Cron Failover Work
options.body: Keep this PR open but separate it from the broader cron outage behavior tracked in the related issue if maintainers want more design review.

recommendation.title: Land Provider-Hook Mappings
